title: Surreal Nightmare Collage
description: A dark surreal composition featuring a green-skinned cracked-face character with glowing yellow eyes on the left, a determined young woman with red hair and facial scars in the center, and a large faded male face with spiral patterns and a yellow skull in its eye on the right. The background contains a gothic castle dripping with orange liquid under a red celestial body, swirling colorful vortexes, and glowing yellow spiders.
prompt: dark surreal fantasy painting featuring a green-skinned zombie-like man with cracked texture and glowing yellow eyes on the left, a young determined woman with long red hair, scars and blood on her face in the center foreground, and a large faded ghostly male face with swirling red and blue vortex patterns and a yellow skull in one eye socket. A gothic dark castle with orange liquid dripping from its towers sits under a glowing red celestial body in the upper left, with glowing yellow spiders and chaotic swirling colorful vortexes filling the composition, eerie and nightmarish atmosphere
